snippet.title: Flooded Burials Demo trailer
snippet.description:
Flooded Burials is a top-down action adventure game about exploring a tower buried in the sea. Play trough stages where you have to face combat and platforming challenges, as well as meet and talk to strange creatures. 
itch.io ( demo ) :https://emlise.itch.io/flooded-burials-demo
steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045030/Flooded_Burials/
